Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T10:01Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts` (`printAutomationSummary`) ⇒ `domain:cli`; rationale: the glyph is this lane's printer.

- **Execution, not a re-ruling.** The maintainer's later direction on #22160, 「预期中的降级记 info」, covers this class. A switch the deployment turned off by its documented default is an expected degradation. #22073's one-line-per-class shape stays; only this class's glyph changes.
- **Pin:** beside #22073's class pins. The policy class is dim `ℹ` with its flows listed. Control: a binding failure keeps `⚠`.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01BmsuLyUeuG5CNpZFMH1jzS`
Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-22255-policy-unbound-info-glyph`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22255`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#1`
File surface: `packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts` (`printAutomationSummary`'s unbound-class loop), `packages/cli/src/utils/format.boot-warning-classes.test.ts`, and `.changeset/22255-*.md` (`@objectstack/cli` patch). ⛔ Not `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, where the summary is built: PR #22381 holds that file. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S, not mechanical`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (opus)`. `dispatch-gates --tier` prints "no path-derived mandate". Telling the policy class apart without matching on prose is a design judgment.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts` (`printAutomationSummary`, this lane's printer) prints the yellow warning glyph | none: `service-automation`'s own per-flow warning is already withheld from Boot diagnostics | every `os dev` / `os start` boot of an app with scheduled flows on the default deployment policy reaches it; it is used today (the showcase boot was measured)
Thread-read: 6057431712
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts` or `format.boot-warning-classes.test.ts` (the REST file lists of the open PRs read this round; PR #22383, #22161 stage 2, changes no `packages/cli` file). Lane siblings in flight: #22310 (`automation.ts`) and #22190 (`collect-docs.ts`, `compile.ts`), both disjoint.

## ACCEPT: PR #22409 (head `62c86cba9`)

<sub>`domain:cli` seat (#6024) · `session_01BmsuLyUeuG5CNpZFMH1jzS` · 2026-10-09T03:16Z. Reviewed against GitHub, not against the report.</sub>

- **Diff read:**
  - `isDeploymentPolicyClass(reason)` is `reason === SCHEDULED_WORK_DISABLED_REASON`, an identity with the producer's constant (`@objectstack/types`, re-exported through `export * from './env.js'`; `@objectstack/cli` declares the package). ⛔ No regex or substring on prose.
  - That class's line prints `chalk.dim` under `ℹ`; every other class keeps `chalk.yellow` and `⚠`. The text, order and `restatedAbove` records are unchanged for both.
- **Identity checked at source:** `scheduledWorkDisabledReason(policy)` returns `policy.hostDisabledReason ?? SCHEDULED_WORK_DISABLED_REASON`. The dev measured 0 non-test producers of `hostDisabledReason` (4 test hits as the control), so on every env-resolved policy the equality is exact. A host-supplied sentence keeps `⚠`, which is the loud direction.
- **Triage direction met:** only this class's glyph changes, and #22073's one-line-per-class shape stays. The pin sits beside #22073's class pins. Controls: a binding failure and a missing trigger keep `⚠`, and `restatedAbove` is unchanged.

- **Out of scope, `Acceptance notes`** (none rises to the filing gate):

Both changesets ship in the same `@objectstack/cli` release, and this one states the move to `ℹ`, so the compiled entry reads correctly in order.
